The best saves from Week 7 of the 2026-27 NHL season are here, featuring incredible paddle stops, last-ditch goal-line robberies and a potential Save of the Year candidate.
Joonas Korpisalo delivers the highlight of the week after Zayne Parekh makes a dazzling move around the Rangers defense, dropping his stick and somehow keeping the wraparound from crossing the goal line. Karel Vejmelka makes another incredible last-ditch stick save to rob Linus Karlsson, while Linus Ullmark lunges across with the paddle to deny Brock Nelson.
Which save was the best of Week 7?
